entries.name: Neutral
entries.description: A blank slate. Ordinary creatures relying on plain strength and instinct, neither strong nor weak against anything.
pros: Never resisted: hits every type for normal damage
Pairs with any second type without adding weaknesses or changing matchups
cons: Never hits anything for bonus damage
Resists nothing

entries.name: Fire
entries.description: Heat, flame and fury. Burns living things and melts metal.
pros: Strong against Grass, Ice and Iron
Resists Fire, Grass, Ice and Iron
cons: Weak to Water and Earth
Fizzles against Water, Earth and other Fire

entries.name: Water
entries.description: Tides, rain and pressure. Quenches flame, erodes stone and shorts out machines.
pros: Strong against Fire, Earth and Virtual
Sets up Soaked for Conduction and Icebound
cons: Weak to Grass and Electric
Absorbed by Grass and other Water

entries.name: Grass
entries.description: Roots, vines and growth. Drinks water and splits stone, but burns easily.
pros: Resists Water, Grass, Electric and Earth
Overgrown fields slow the enemy and fuel Wildfire
cons: Weak to Fire and Ice
Can't cut through Fire, Grass or Iron

entries.name: Electric
entries.description: Lightning and current. Races through water and metal, and overloads machines.
pros: Strong against Water, Iron and Virtual
cons: Weak to Earth
Has no effect at all on Earth
Dissipates into Grass and other Electric

entries.name: Ice
entries.description: Frost and cold. Freezes plants and cracks the ground, but melts under heat.
pros: Frosted fields set up Icebound and Steam
cons: Weak to Fire and Iron
Struggles against Fire, Ice and Iron

entries.name: Earth
entries.description: Stone, sand and soil. Grounds lightning, smothers fire and crushes metal.
pros: Strong against Fire, Electric and Iron
cons: Weak to Water, Grass and Ice
Can't touch what isn't solid: weak against Ghost and Grass

entries.name: Magic
entries.description: Arcane power, runes and enchantment. Banishes spirits and wards off darkness.
cons: Weak to Mental and Iron (focus breaks spells; cold iron grounds them)
Can't overcome Iron, Virtual or other Magic

entries.name: Mental
entries.description: Psychic force, willpower and illusion. Overwhelms simple minds and disrupts spellcasting.
cons: Weak to Ghost, Dark and Virtual: fragile defensively; Mental and Ghost are each strong against the other
Little effect on Iron, Dark, Virtual or other Mental

entries.name: Iron
entries.description: Metal, armour and machinery. A defensive wall that shatters ice and grounds magic.
pros: Resists Grass, Ice, Magic, Mental, Dark, Light and Iron
cons: Weak to Fire, Electric, Earth and Virtual
Few offensive targets; struggles against Fire, Water, Electric and Iron

entries.name: Virtual
entries.description: Digital constructs and living code. Hacks machines and floods minds with data.
cons: Weak to Water, Electric and Ghost (shorts, surges, and things in the machine)
Can't parse Magic; weak against Electric, Ghost and other Virtual

entries.name: Ghost
entries.description: Spirits and echoes of the departed. Haunts minds and possesses machines; hard to pin down.
cons: Weak to Magic, Light and Mental: Mental and Ghost are each strong against the other
Fades against Dark and Light

entries.name: Dark
entries.description: Shadow, stealth and fear. Clouds the mind and swallows light.
cons: Weak to Magic and Light
Held back by Magic wards, Iron and other Dark

entries.name: Light
entries.description: Radiance and purity. Dispels shadows and spirits, but glances off polished metal.
cons: Weak to Dark: Light and Dark are each strong against the other
Only two offensive targets; Iron and other Light resist it
